hints: Focus on what actually causes acid rain, which acidic gases dissolved in rainwater make it acidic?
Remember that $\text{SO}_2$, $\text{SO}_3$ and nitrogen oxides like $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ all lead to strong acids, while removing them helps.
Check which reaction creates those acidic oxides and which one actually removes them from exhaust gases.
walkthrough:
**Recall what causes acid rain**

Acid rain is caused when acidic non-metal oxides dissolve in water in the atmosphere. The two main culprits are sulfur oxides and nitrogen oxides.

Key dissolutions:
$$\text{SO}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$$
$$2\text{NO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{HNO}_2 + \text{HNO}_3$$

**Check the reactions that make the problem worse**

Combustion of fossil fuels releases $\text{SO}_2$ from sulfur impurities and $\text{NO}$ from high temperature reaction of $\text{N}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$. Then $\text{SO}_2$ is oxidised to $\text{SO}_3$, catalysed by $\text{NO}_2$, and $\text{SO}_3$ reacts with water to give sulfuric acid.

$$\text{S} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{SO}_2$$
$$\text{SO}_2 + \tfrac{1}{2}\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{SO}_3$$

**Spot the reaction that helps, not harms**

In a catalytic converter, $\text{NO}$ and $\text{CO}$ react to give harmless nitrogen and carbon dioxide. This removes a cause of acid rain instead of creating one.

$$2\text{NO} + 2\text{CO} \rightarrow \text{N}_2 + 2\text{CO}_2$$
So this is the one that does not contribute to acid rain.

options.A: Combustion of fossil fuels does contribute. Sulfur impurities burn to $\text{SO}_2$ and high temperatures allow $\text{N}_2 + \text{O}_2$ to form $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$, both of which form acids in rain.
options.B: This oxidation does contribute. Converting $\text{SO}_2$ to $\text{SO}_3$ is a key step toward forming sulfuric acid, $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$, in acid rain. $\text{NO}_2$ acting as a catalyst here also shows how nitrogen oxides worsen sulfur pollution.
options.C: This reaction does not contribute, it helps prevent acid rain. The catalytic converter converts polluting $\text{NO}$ and toxic $\text{CO}$ into harmless $\text{N}_2$ and $\text{CO}_2$, removing nitrogen oxides that would otherwise form nitric acid.
options.D: This reaction directly contributes. $\text{SO}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ produces the sulfuric acid found in acid rain, which lowers pH and damages buildings and lakes.
